plan.title: Donation Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Monthly trends, top cities, payment modes, and donor retention

panels.title: Monthly Trend
panels.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST("Date" AS TIMESTAMP)) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top Cities by Donation Amount
panels.sql: SELECT "City", SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "City" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Payment Modes Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Mode" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Repeat Donors (Top 10)
panels.sql: SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donation_count, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative:
The dashboard highlights key metrics such as {{p1}} in total donations and {{p2}} unique donors. The average donation amount stands at {{p3}}.

The monthly trend shows how donations have evolved over time, with the most recent month contributing significantly to the total. Top cities like those listed in the bar chart drive a large portion of the revenue.

Payment modes vary, with UPI and Card being the most popular methods. Repeat donors, shown in the table, are crucial for sustained growth, with some individuals contributing multiple times.
